title: Activating user actions button should not use this big screen-wide button on overview
body:
**AAPS 3.3 dev**

_Suggestion_:
Automation user action uses a big screen-wide button on AAPS overview.
Imho the button is to ease to hit by accident and uses far too much valuable screen space in overview (more than 10%)? 

_Feature request:_
When using the new Wear tile for user-type automations: add an option for users for showing user action on the wear tile only, not on phone (as with quick actions)?

I can see several other options here.
- Moving user automation buttons to the "Actions" tab, or even a separate "Automations tab"?
- Moving user automation buttons to a new/separate "Automations" tab?
- Make the button much smaller.
